name: Cursor ACP
description: ACP runtime backend for Cursor CLI. Spawns `agent acp` and communicates over stdio. Use backend "cursor-acp" and agent "cursor" with acp.allowedAgents.

command.label: Cursor agent command
command.help: Path to Cursor CLI (default: agent). Use full path if agent is not on PATH.

cwd.label: Default working directory
cwd.help: Default cwd for ACP sessions when not set per session.

permissionOutcome.label: Tool permission outcome
permissionOutcome.help: Response to session/request_permission from Cursor: allow-once, allow-always, or reject-once.

trustWorkspace.label: Trust workspace (--trust)
trustWorkspace.help: Pass Cursor CLI --trust so the workspace is trusted without prompting (headless). Default true. Set false to rely on Cursor-side trust only (e.g. open folder in Cursor and trust once).

env.label: Environment for agent process
env.help: Optional env vars for the spawned Cursor process (e.g. HOME). Set HOME to the same value as where you ran `agent login` if the gateway runs with a different environment.
